mapper.select: SELECT w.workspace_id FROM workspaces w JOIN workspace_domains d ON w.workspace_id = d.workspace_id WHERE d.domain_key = #{domainKey} AND d.active = 'Y'
mapper.sql: (SELECT md.name FROM project_members pm JOIN workspace_members wm ON pm.workspace_member_id = wm.workspace_member_id JOIN member_details md ON wm.member_id = md.member_id WHERE pm.project_id = p.project_id AND pm.status = 0 AND pm.role = ( SELECT MAX(role) FROM project_members WHERE project_id = p.project_id AND status = 0 ) AND ROWNUM = 1 ) AS pm_name
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM project_members WHERE project_id = p.project_id AND status = 0 ) AS member_count
mapper.select:
SELECT p.project_id, p.workspace_id, p.subject, p.content, TO_CHAR(p.start_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS start_date, TO_CHAR(p."END", 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS end_date, p.status, p.progress, p.archive, TO_CHAR(p.created, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS created, ,
FROM projects p WHERE p.workspace_id = #{workspace_id} AND p.deleted IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM workspace_members actor WHERE actor.workspace_id = p.workspace_id AND actor.member_id = #{actorId} AND actor.status = 0 AND (actor.role = 70 OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM project_members own WHERE own.project_id = p.project_id AND own.workspace_member_id = actor.workspace_member_id AND own.role = 50 AND own.status = 0))) ORDER BY p.project_id DESC

SELECT NVL(MAX(CASE WHEN actor.role = 70 THEN 70 WHEN own.role = 50 AND own.status = 0 THEN 50 ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM projects p JOIN workspace_members actor ON actor.workspace_id = p.workspace_id AND actor.member_id = #{actorId} AND actor.status = 0 LEFT JOIN project_members own ON own.project_id = p.project_id AND own.workspace_member_id = actor.workspace_member_id WHERE p.project_id = #{projectId} AND p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND p.deleted IS NULL

SELECT p.project_id FROM project_members pm JOIN projects p ON pm.project_id = p.project_id WHERE pm.project_member_id = #{projectMemberId} AND p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND p.deleted IS NULL AND pm.status = 0

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM project_members pm JOIN workspace_members wm ON pm.workspace_member_id = wm.workspace_member_id JOIN projects p ON pm.project_id = p.project_id WHERE pm.project_member_id = #{projectMemberId} AND p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND wm.member_id = #{actorId} AND wm.workspace_id = p.workspace_id AND wm.role = 70 AND wm.status = 0 AND pm.role = 70 AND pm.status = 0 AND p.deleted IS NULL
SELECT role FROM workspace_members WHERE workspace_member_id = #{workspaceMemberId} AND workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND status = 0
SELECT MAX(workspace_member_id) FROM workspace_members WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND member_id = #{actorId} AND status = 0 AND role = 70

SELECT t.task_id AS "taskId", t.title AS "title", p.subject AS "projectName", TO_CHAR(t.start_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "startAt", TO_CHAR(t."END", 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "endAt", t.progress AS "progress" FROM tasks t JOIN projects p ON t.project_id = p.project_id WHERE p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND p.deleted IS NULL AND t.deleted IS NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM workspace_members actor WHERE actor.workspace_id = p.workspace_id AND actor.member_id = #{memberId} AND actor.status = 0 AND (actor.role = 70 OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM project_members own WHERE own.project_id = p.project_id AND own.workspace_member_id = actor.workspace_member_id AND own.status = 0 )) ) ORDER BY t.start_at, t.task_id
